related_issues.reason: Closed as completed: uv support for PEP 792 project status markers, the standard that defines the 'quarantined' status the reporter hit. Context for why uv sees this status at all, not the same request (the reporter asks for a clearer error message).

Similar symptom class: an index-side block (HTTP 403 from an in-band scanner on a mirror) makes resolution fail, and uv does not explain it well. Different requested outcome (backtracking vs. a clearer message), so related only.

rationale: The reporter's template says bug, but uv appears to be doing its job: the PyPI JSON simple API reports guardrails-ai with project-status 'quarantined' and no files, so the resolver cannot find any versions and fails. The request is for a clearer, quarantine-specific message and a different error format, which is an enhancement under the playbook (behaviour as designed, reporter asks for a change). Not external: the status comes from the standard PEP 792 marker on pypi.org, not a defect in another tool. No needs_mre: the post has the command, full output, and uv version, and the reproduction is public. Search for duplicates (quarantined, project status, index policy error messages) found no open issue asking for the same message change; the docs search returned no pages. Related issues listed above. Search tools worked; no failures.
